answer.reason: In Table 1 of the EIA Idaho Electricity Profile 2024, the net generation attributed to Electric utilities is 6,560,126 megawatthours. This is consistent with Idaho's overall utility-scale generation of roughly 15-16 million MWh, of which electric utilities (e.g., Idaho Power) account for about 6.5 million MWh while independent power producers/CHP account for the larger remainder. The 13,475,312 MWh figure is far too large for the Electric utilities category in Idaho.
